2026-10-09PSPC, CPCCanada Post Corporation ActRegulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the Canada Post Corporation Act (Miscellaneous Program)Regulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the Canada Post Corporation Act (Miscellaneous Program) in order to (1) repeal obsolete or spent provisions that have no current application; and (2) make coordinating amendments to ensure information on size and weight limits found in these provisions is retained.Registration: SOR/2026-0207 Publication Date: 2026-10-21
subject: Regulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the Canada Post Corporation Act (Miscellaneous Program)
precis: Regulations Amending Certain Regulations Made Under the Canada Post Corporation Act (Miscellaneous Program) in order to (1) repeal obsolete or spent provisions that have no current application; and (2) make coordinating amendments to ensure information on size and weight limits found in these provisions is retained.
